exact_sha256.rule: A content SHA-256 may occur in only one role. Re-encoding does not bypass the remaining checks.

perceptual_near_duplicate.rule: Compare only like algorithms, including normalized forms produced by the audited offline leakage tool. Unknown or incompatible hash algorithms cannot be treated as a pass.

crop_overlap.verification: A perceptual candidate requires bounded local-feature/geometric verification before exclusion; an unavailable configured verification makes admission incomplete, never passed.
crop_overlap.rule: A crop or screenshot derived from another split inherits the source asset's role and cannot enter a different role.

rotation_mirror_equivalence.rule: Hash and crop checks cover declared rotations and horizontal mirrors; transformed assets do not become independent samples.

sequence_adjacency.rule: The full known source sequence is assigned to one role. The frame window is a fallback for legacy manifests and never permits known sequence splitting. Every locked-holdout query requires a distinct non-null sequence ID.

same_capture_run.rule: All assets from the same capture mission, upload batch, flight, drive, or contracted delivery stay in one role even when provider sequence IDs differ. Every locked-holdout query requires a distinct non-null capture-run ID.

same_contributor_or_source_asset.holdout_contributor_rule: Use contributors independent of reference construction wherever identity can be resolved. A common corporate owner does not establish contributor independence; unresolved identity or an undocumented contributor overlap is quarantined and cannot be assumed safe.
same_contributor_or_source_asset.rule: The same source image, parent panorama/frame, source tile, contributor capture session, or derivative family cannot cross roles. A holdout source name cannot appear in a reference role. Contributor identity alone is not globally disqualifying outside the holdout, but all of that contributor's same route/session is grouped.

descriptor_similarity.rule: Use only real descriptors from the exactly pinned model and complete audited coverage. Missing, random, hash-derived, test, or partially covered vectors make this check incomplete. Thresholds are conservative planning defaults and require calibration on a clean pilot before Expansion.

spatial_buffer.rule: Holdout query locations are separated from development/validation query locations by at least five kilometres, and same-view street references within one kilometre of holdout truth are excluded. Geographic proximity to a predeclared blind national aerial grid is permitted only as the intended cross-view retrieval relationship; no cell may be selected or centered from holdout truth.

temporal_proximity.rule: Assets within plus or minus 30 days and a shared source/sequence, contributor/run, or spatial cell are not independent across roles. Null capture time is never silently assumed safe.

satellite_patch_overlap.blind_grid_exception: A nationally predeclared reference grid may geographically cover a holdout street location only when its geometry and retention policy were frozen before holdout truth access. It may not reuse pixels from an aerial/satellite query in another role.
satellite_patch_overlap.rule: No raster pixels, source tiles, parent scenes, or overlapping crops cross train/development/validation/holdout query roles. Patch adjacency is grouped when provider resampling or crop padding could reuse pixels.

operator_smoke_image_exclusion.rule: The two operator Kayseri/Ankara smoke images, known answers, coordinates, hashes, viewpoints, crops, and nearby targeted captures are unavailable to planning, acquisition, reference construction, model selection, and holdout creation. A future intake row marked as operator smoke is rejected before any asset bytes are read by corpus tooling.

benchmark_truth_isolation.rule: The scoring process loads location truth only after all frozen-query predictions complete. Reference builders, model-selection jobs, inference workers, logs, prompts, and environment variables never receive the truth manifest or its key.

audit_receipt_requirements.rule: A failed or incomplete audit remains failed or incomplete after filtering. Admission requires a separate clean rerun and both receipts are retained.
